experiment: E3a physics-informed vs data-only modal transfer at matched capacity
load_family: smooth_mixture (25 signed sine modes, unit norm, qscale 1 Pa)
model_class: H~(x): tensor Legendre polynomial, total degree d, fixed domain box -> [-1,1]^3; loads applied through the analytic Navier basis

rules.selection: per arm, budget and seed: minimize validation median field error, then validation p95
rules.target: in-domain target: validation median <= 1.0% and p95 <= 3.0% (mean over seeds)
rules.H1: H1 (label efficiency) is supported at label budget N if the 95% bootstrap interval of the median per-design paired difference (data-only error minus hybrid error, each averaged over seeds) on the 30 validation designs lies entirely above 0. Evaluated at N = 10, 20 and 40; reported for all N.
rules.label_free: physics-only reaches the target label-free if any M meets it; report the smallest such M
rules.capacity: capacity curve: validation error versus degree with the best ridge, for physics-only at M = 560 and data-only at N = 140; a floor that does not move with more data or collocation indicates the model class, not the information, limits accuracy

collocation: scrambled Halton (seed 1000+seed), transformed domain, quantized to 10 significant digits, nested in M, min distance to validation/test designs asserted > 1e-6

rules.selection: per arm, budget and seed: minimize validation median field error, then validation p95
rules.target: in-domain target: validation median <= 1.0% and p95 <= 3.0% (mean over seeds)
rules.H1: H1 (label efficiency) is supported at label budget N if the 95% bootstrap interval of the median per-design paired difference (data-only error minus hybrid error, each averaged over seeds) on the 30 validation designs lies entirely above 0. Evaluated at N = 10, 20 and 40; reported for all N.
rules.label_free: physics-only reaches the target label-free if any M meets it; report the smallest such M
rules.capacity: capacity curve: validation error versus degree with the best ridge, for physics-only at M = 560 and data-only at N = 140; a floor that does not move with more data or collocation indicates the model class, not the information, limits accuracy

cost_note: Labels: one 5x5 solve per mode per labelled design. Physics: one 5x5 matrix assembly per mode per collocation design, no solve. On this simply supported family both are microsecond-scale, so H1 here is a methodological test of label efficiency, not a practical cost saving.
